Software Development Engineer (Backend - Magento)

We are looking for a Backend Developer with strong expertise in Magento 2 (Adobe Commerce) to build and maintain scalable e-commerce solutions. The role involves designing and developing scalable backend solutions in Magento, delivering seamless multi-region and multi-currency experiences while driving performance, security, and conversion optimization across the e-commerce platform.

Experience: 4+ Years (5+ years hands-on experience in Magento 2 preferred)

Location: Chennai

Employment Type: Full-time

  • What You'll Do
    • Design and develop scalable backend solutions in Magento 2, delivering multi-region and multi-currency e-commerce experiences.
    • Build and maintain headless Magento PWA websites, integrating with backend services via APIs.
    • Build and integrate GraphQL, REST APIs, and third-party systems.
    • Integrate third-party systems including ERP, PIM, payment gateways, shipping/logistics, and inventory platforms.
    • Troubleshoot and resolve backend issues, including checkout, cart logic, and third-party conflicts.
    • Manage platform upgrades, patches, and data migrations while maintaining security standards.
    • Drive performance optimization across the platform using MySQL, Redis, and Varnish/Fastly.
  • What Makes You a Great Fit
    • 4+ years of backend development experience, with 5+ years of hands-on experience in Magento 2 (Adobe Commerce) preferred.
    • Strong expertise in Magento architecture, custom modules, plugins, and backend customizations.
    • Proficiency in MySQL, Redis, Varnish/Fastly, and platform performance optimization.
    • Strong understanding of platform security, upgrades, patches, and data migrations.
    • Knowledge of headless commerce, API-first architectures, and e-commerce best practices.
    • Adobe Commerce (Magento) certifications will be a bonus.

Experience: 4+ Years

Location: Chennai

Employment Type: Full-time

      • Build scalable, high-performance web applications using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript.

Location: Pune/Chennai

Cloud Infrastructure Architect

We are looking for an experienced Infrastructure Architect to design and drive scalable, secure, and high-performing infrastructure solutions across cloud and on-premises environments. The role focuses on cloud architecture, networking, automation, security, and infrastructure strategy to support business growth and operational excellence.

Experience: 8+ Years

Location: Chennai

Employment Type: Full-time

  • What You'll Do
    • Design and drive infrastructure architecture strategy across cloud and on-premises environments to support business growth.
    • Architect, deploy, and manage scalable, secure cloud environments on AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.
    • Build and maintain networking infrastructure: TCP/IP, routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, and load balancers.
    • Manage and secure Windows Server, Linux, Active Directory, DNS, and DHCP environments.
    • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, and Bash to automate provisioning and operations.
    • Administer and optimize virtualization platforms such as VMware and Hyper-V.
    • Implement cybersecurity, compliance, and risk management controls, along with backup, disaster recovery, and high-availability strategies.
    • Lead root-cause analysis and troubleshooting for complex infrastructure and network issues.
  • What Makes You a Great Fit
    • 8+ years of experience in infrastructure architecture, systems engineering, or enterprise infrastructure management.
    • Strong experience with cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.
    • Proven expertise designing, managing, and securing scalable on-premises and cloud environments.
    • Solid networking knowledge including TCP/IP, routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, and load balancers.
    • Hands-on experience with Windows Server, Linux, Active Directory, DNS, and DHCP.
    • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), Ansible, PowerShell, Bash, and other automation tools.
    • Experience with virtualization technologies such as VMware, Hyper-V, or similar platforms.
    • Strong understanding of cybersecurity, compliance, risk management, backup, disaster recovery, and high availability.
    • Proven troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills for complex infrastructure and network issues.
